operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 silver segment revenue was ₹4,032 Cr against ₹1,688 Cr a year earlier, and FY26 silver revenue was ₹9,841 Cr.
FY26 mining royalty was ₹4,948 Cr against ₹4,103 Cr in FY25, and power and fuel fell to ₹2,553 Cr from ₹2,702 Cr.
The company raised ₹1,400 Cr via privately placed non-convertible debentures on February 02, 2026, fully utilised with no deviation.
Zinc CoP excluding royalty stood at $903 per tonne in Q4FY26.
Q4FY26 Zinc CoP excluding royalty stood at $903 per tonne.
Chanderiya Lead Zinc Smelter became India's first Zinc Mark site under the Copper Mark Assurance Process.
Hindustan Zinc signed an MoU with Group Nirmal to set up a zinc wire facility at Zinc Industrial Park in Khankhala, Bhilwara, Rajasthan.
Rampura Agucha Mine became India's first Zinc Mark certified mine under the Copper Mark Assurance Framework.
Signed MoU with TERI for a 250-hectare ecological restoration project at Chanderiya Lead Zinc Smelter Complex.
Renewable energy was about 18% of the power mix in FY26, up from about 13%, with targets of 35% by FY27 and 70% by FY28.
FY26 had 2 contractor fatalities and 1 high-consequence contractor injury; employee fatalities were nil.
Board approved India's first zinc tailings reprocessing plant at Rampura Agucha with 10 MTPA feed capacity; no cost or timeline disclosed.
Q2FY27 silver segment revenue was ₹4,111 Cr against ₹1,707 Cr a year earlier; zinc, lead and others ₹10,414 Cr against ₹6,528 Cr.
Mining royalty was ₹1,553 Cr in Q2FY27 against ₹1,007 Cr a year earlier, and power and fuel ₹734 Cr against ₹646 Cr.

The Enforcement Directorate conducted a search and seizure operation under FEMA at Hindustan Zinc's premises from June 1, 2026 to June 3, 2026; the company says it has received no further communication.
Q2FY27 mined metal production was a record second-quarter 271 KT (+5% YoY) and refined metal 264 KT (+7% YoY).
Q2FY27 silver production was 173 tonnes (+20% YoY); 1H silver output of 321 tonnes contributed about 45% of overall profitability.
Free cash flow pre growth capex was ₹6,389 Cr in Q2FY27 and ₹11,642 Cr in 1HFY27; 1H contribution to the national exchequer was ₹13,027 Cr.
Q2 FY27 capex stood at ₹1,200 crores sustaining and ₹700 crores growth capex.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹13,544 Cr (+49.0% YoY), net profit ₹5,033 Cr (+67.6% YoY).
Hindustan Zinc approved the appointment of M S K A & Associates LLP as statutory auditor for a five-year term, subject to shareholder approval.
Hindustan Zinc reported record Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹13,544 Cr and net profit of ₹5,033 Cr.
Hindustan Zinc reported record Q4FY26 revenue of ₹13,544 Cr and net profit of ₹5,033 Cr, and guided FY27 mined metal production at 1,150 KT.
Hindustan Zinc announced that its Chanderiya Lead Zinc Smelter became India's first Zinc Mark validated site.
Hindustan Zinc received an administrative warning letter from SEBI on April 30, 2026, concerning procedural aspects of audit committee approvals and disclosures.
Hindustan Zinc announced the resignation of Chief Financial Officer Sandeep Modi effective May 30, 2026.
Hindustan Zinc signed an MoU with Group Nirmal on May 12, 2026, to set up a zinc wire facility at its Zinc Industrial Park in Rajasthan.
Hindustan Zinc reported that promoter VRL amended its facility agreement to upsize the total facility to US$ 600 million with restrictive covenants on HZL.
Vedanta submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31 on April 16, 2026, regarding a US$ 125 million facility agreement affecting Hindustan Zinc shareholding covenants.
Hindustan Zinc's Rampura Agucha mine achieved India's first Zinc Mark certification under the Copper Mark Assurance Framework.
On May 29, 2026, Hindustan Zinc extended CEO Arun Misra's tenure to July 31, 2026, and appointed Amit Gupta as CFO effective June 1, 2026.
Hindustan Zinc disclosed that the Directorate of Enforcement conducted a search operation at its premises from June 1 to 3, 2026.
Hindustan Zinc issued AGM notice and dispatched Integrated Annual Report information for the 60th AGM to be held on June 29, 2026.
Hindustan Zinc clarified to the Exchange on June 5, 2026, that its response was awaited regarding news of a possible government stake sale.
Hindustan Zinc signed an MoU with TERI for a 250-hectare ecological restoration project at Chanderiya.

Hindustan Zinc filed its FY26 Sustainability Report on 16 October 2026: renewable share about 18% of power, 2 contractor fatalities, 3.32x water positive, and a board-approved 10 MTPA tailings reprocessing plant at Rampura Agucha.
Hindustan Zinc shareholders approved postal ballot resolutions for appointing Amarendu Prakash as CEO and Yogesh Attray as Independent Director.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹15,093 Cr (+76.5% YoY), net profit ₹6,412 Cr (+142.1% YoY).
2026-10-19: Hindustan Zinc press release on Q2FY27 results: revenue ₹15,093 Cr (+77% YoY), EBITDA ₹9,285 Cr (+108%), net profit ₹6,412 Cr (+142%), zinc COP ex-royalty $703/t.
Hindustan Zinc reported earnings call details for Q2 FY27, revising full-year zinc COP guidance to $825-$850/t.
